Name: Tiny Mita MiSide ( Krobus )
Author: Valein
Description:
Replace Krobus' Portrait and Sprite with Tiny Mita MiSide

You need Content Patcher to install this mod!!!

If you want to switch to an alternative, you'll need Generic Mod Config Menu or you can change it manually.There's also a bonus for the Krobus trenchcoat portrait that includes glasses; you can switch to it manually.

Note : To switch to the alternative (generic mod config menu) on Android, you need to tap and hold the option and drag it to the "alter" option, instead of just tapping it.
